D5/S3/DivergenceSupport/LandauerSaturati.name: D5.S3.DivergenceSupport.LandauerSaturation.landauer_saturation_iff
D5/S3/DivergenceSupport/LandauerSaturati.signature: theorem landauer_saturation_iff (beta heat entropyChange mutualInfo divergence : Real) (hbalance : beta * heat = -entropyChange + mutualInfo + divergence) (hmutualInfo : 0 <= mutualInfo) (hdivergence : 0 <= divergence) : -entropyChange = beta * heat ↔ mutualInfo = 0 ∧ divergence = 0

D5/S3/DivergenceSupport/LandauerSaturati.name: D5.S3.DivergenceSupport.LandauerSaturation.landauer_strict_iff
D5/S3/DivergenceSupport/LandauerSaturati.signature: theorem landauer_strict_iff (beta heat entropyChange mutualInfo divergence : Real) (hbalance : beta * heat = -entropyChange + mutualInfo + divergence) (hmutualInfo : 0 <= mutualInfo) (hdivergence : 0 <= divergence) : -entropyChange < beta * heat ↔ 0 < mutualInfo + divergence
